title: Redwood All-Hands - July 2026
customer_attendees: Selected remote attendees: EMEA & APAC offices
summary: Monthly company all-hands covering Q2 results, product launches for Dedicated and Private, hiring plan, security roadmap, and open Q&A. Leadership provided metrics on revenue, usage, and reliability; previewed upcoming features; and outlined hiring/OKR changes. Several action items and follow-ups assigned.
transcript: 00:00 Sam Turner: Good morning everyone, welcome to the July all hands, thanks for joining. we'll go about an hour plus, so please be mindful of time. 00:12 Ava Chen: Quick housekeeping - slides are in the #all-hands channel, link in chat, and we'll record. 00:20 Miguel Santos: Quick shoutout to infra team, p99 latency dropped after the kernel selection fixes, so big thumbs up. 00:34 Sam Turner: Awesome. OK Q2 in a minute but first product - Priya? 00:41 Priya Kapoor: Thanks Sam. So on Redwood Dedicated we shipped the burst capacity feature last month, customers are seeing better tail behavior during spikes. early metrics: avg throughput per-GPU up 8% on typical largechat workloads. note - that 8 percent is from internal benching, so YMMV, but it's trending. 01:02 (some crosstalk) 01:08 Jordan Lee: Can we get the customer facing doc link? I dropped it in chat. 01:12 Priya Kapoor: yes, sent. Also Private deployment: we've got the VPC private-control-plane beta ready, early adopters in finance vertical. one caveat, we saw an onboarding gap around customer KMS integration - SEs are fixing the guide. 01:28 Ava Chen: On that KMS note, there's a perf tradeoff if you do per-request KMS unwraps vs envelope keys, so we'll add a recommended pattern in the doc. sometimes the transcript spells KMS as K-M-S, ok. 01:42 Sam Turner: Good. All right Q2 numbers - Miguel? 01:46 Miguel Santos: Quick slide - revenue came in at $11.2M ARR net new, beat plan by 6%. usage: token volume growth 28% q/q, driven largely by new AI-native start-up cohort. request success rate 99.96% - still chasing that 99.99 but improvement vs last quarter. cost per token improved ~11% due to batching improvements and better kernel selection. 02:15 Ava Chen: small correction - the batching change affected small models more; for larger context lengths the cache improvements were the biggest. transcription sometimes shows 'AvA' weird but it's me. 02:30 Sam Turner: Nice work. Any large customer wins? 02:33 Jordan Lee: We closed a mid-market deal with AtlasHealth - Dedicated deployment, healthcare use case. they're in initial SOC 2 paperwork. 02:42 Sam Turner: Nice. Ok hiring - Leah? 02:45 Leah Morgan: Hiring update: we're opening 28 new roles this quarter, big focus on infra (serving/runtime) and SEs for Private onboarding. ramp plan: targeted hiring for EMEA to support timezone coverage. compensation review finished, see HR doc in the channel. 03:05 Miguel Santos: note on org: we combined the continuous-batching team with compilation to reduce handoffs; Miguel and Ava will share a roadmap owner. 03:15 Priya Kapoor: product roadmap - next 90 days: 1) GA: Dedicated burst + SLA page; 2) Private: VPC GA for small clusters; 3) Optimize: intelligent batching suggestions in console alpha. 03:32 Sam Turner: Questions so far before we go to security? 03:35 (pause, some chatter) 03:40 Leah Morgan: Quick reminder - equity Q&A town hall next week. 03:45 Ava Chen: Security update - Priya and I will kick off. actually Miguel first on reliability. 03:50 Miguel Santos: reliability: we increased automated failover coverage, runbooks updated, and are rolling an analytic on fallbacks when model variants are used. that reduced customer-visible retries by 12% in June. 04:05 Ava Chen: Security & compliance: we completed ISO27001 scoping, third-party audit scheduled in Q3. SOC 2 type II readiness in progress, audit prelim next month. on SSO, new SAML metadata automations will reduce onboarding time by ~40%. note: some transcripts render SAML as 'sam L' for no reason. 04:28 Sam Turner: Good. Any legal/compliance asks? 04:31 Priya Kapoor: A customers in EU asked about data residency and audit log retention - we now offer per-tenant retention configs in Private and Dedicated, docs forthcoming. 04:44 Jordan Lee: Pricing note: we're testing per-route quotas for PLG customers to handle bursty usage. that'll help predictability for teams. 04:56 Sam Turner: OK let's go to Q&A - please raise hands in Zoom. 05:00 Audience Question (Speaker 1): What's the timeline for on-prem option? 05:05 Ava Chen: on-prem package is targeted for Q4, but pilot customers need a few weeks of validation; the package will include HSM/KMS integration docs and air-gapped install playbook. 05:18 Audience Question (Speaker 2): Any plans for multi-region active-active routing? 05:25 Miguel Santos: yes, smart routing is on the roadmap; initial phase is cross-region failover and then true active-active once replication latencies are solved. 05:38 Audience Question (Speaker 3): How are we handling model drift/regression monitoring? 05:45 Priya Kapoor: Redwood Optimize will support eval sets and regression alerts tied to prompts; alpha customers are experimenting with prompt-based checks. 05:56 (murmur) 06:00 Audience Question (Speaker 4): Is Dedicated still recommended for guaranteed latency vs Hosted? 06:05 Ava Chen: yes for strict p95/p99 SLOs Dedicated is best; Hosted is great for quick integration and cheaper for bursty low-SLA usage. 06:15 Audience Question (Speaker 5): Any competitor updates? 06:18 Sam Turner: We track a few - mention of CloudGen AI, BigCompute, and ModelServe. nothing dramatic, but pricing pressure in some segments. 06:30 (chat: link to Q2 deck) 06:35 Sam Turner: Ok closing notes: thanks team - retention and revenue movement looks healthy but we need to keep shipping. 06:45 Leah Morgan: people updates - promotions announced in HR channel, congrats to this quarter's promoted folks. 06:55 Priya Kapoor: action items for product and SE teams - we'll sync on KMS onboarding doc and GA checklist. 07:02 Sam Turner: final recap and next steps. please review the slides and fill out the follow-up survey. 07:12 (meeting ends, recording stops)

SEs to update KMS onboarding guide and share PR (Riley / SE team)
Schedule pilot for on-prem package with finance customers (Jordan)
